prompts.empty_calls:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE production illustration for an empty prediction-call feed in the Chumbucket mobile app. Image 1 is the brand/style reference, NOT a background to reproduce. Preserve its distinctive pink, tapered bucket-shaped little building, riveted broad curved rim, three cyan portholes, purple bent pipe and small arched door. Same charming hand-inked dark-plum outlines and restrained cel-shaded painted cartoon finish, simplified to remain crisp at 140 logical pixels.
Scene: the bucket-house is quiet, with a single blank speech-bubble-shaped notice card on a little stand beside the door; the notice card has no marks or writing. Slightly curious/inviting mood, not sad or abandoned. This means "no one has posted a call yet", not a financial loss.
Centered isolated compact composition, house is hero, one small supporting prop only. All objects fully visible with 10% outer margin. Square 1024x1024 asset. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background, no white rectangle, no checkerboard painted into the image, no scenery, no ground plane except a tiny faint contact shadow. Pink/coral #FF3355 and #FF5A76, cyan windows and muted purple pipes derived from reference; dark-plum ink. No words, lettering, numbers, currency, coins, charts, trophy, people, logos/wordmarks, watermark, sparkle confetti, 3D plastic or photorealism. Retain building shape; do not add eyes, face, arms or legs. This is an illustration asset, not a screenshot or UI card.
